name: unprotectedResourcesCount
definition: The number of distinct devices a backup plan has not yet been applied to (the union of each plan's backup_pending_on list) across the backup plans the tool reads. An error, refusal, empty read, or any plan without a backup_pending_on list is Not evaluated, never 0.
population: the backup plans the credential's company returns; numerator = distinct device ids in backup_pending_on across every plan read
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A read of the backup plans in which every plan carries a backup_pending_on list; 0 only when every list is present and empty. An error, refusal, empty or partial read is Not evaluated.

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real IDrive body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: Only devices already assigned to a plan and pending are counted; devices with no plan at all are not visible in getBackupPlan and are not counted. A missing, null or string backup_pending_on is not read as zero.
